section_summary: This section contains a telephone file note dated November 16, 1949. The Pacific Military Permit Branch reported that U.S. President Lines had supplied previously requested information.

people.name: L. Mellor
people.role: Recipient of the telephone call and apparent author of the file note

subfiles.title: Telephone note concerning information furnished to the Pacific Military Permit Branch
subfiles.about: Records confirmation that U.S. President Lines had furnished requested information to the Pacific Military Permit Branch.
subfiles.summary: The Army branch telephoned Mrs. Mellor to confirm that U.S. President Lines had supplied the requested information.
